Quality is a first-class priority for us, not a phase at the end. You'll work closely with developers, Product, Customer Support and your Engineering Manager. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own quality for a service or product area end to end — test strategy, automation, release sign-off, and follow-up on escaped bugs. Test strategy. Decide what to automate, what to test by hand, and what risk is acceptable for each release. Automation that lasts. Build and extend API, UI and integration test suites that are fast, reliable and run in CI on every change. Shift left. Review designs and requirements early, and work with developers so testability is built in, not bolted on. Learn from escapes. When a bug reaches customers, find out why and close the gap so it doesn't happen again. Raise the bar. Review test code, mentor SDET-1s, and help interview candidates. Ownership, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. title: Senior Web Frontend Engineer (6 Monate befristet)

Von Vorteil Praktische Erfahrung mit React.js, idealerweise in umfangreichen Anwendungen im Produktivbetrieb. Erfahrung mit Next.js und serverseitigem Rendering (SSR). The Iron Mountain platform is an enabler for Amazon advertising rapid growth and offers a singular platform to manage all of the advertiser facing functions like billing, invoicing, accounting automation, budgets, promotions, payments, and Billing Advertiser Experience(AX) in real-time while being transparent and audit-able from the ground-up. As a part of this high-energy, entrepreneurial team you will get an opportunity to innovate on solutions that control the very levers of our advertisers' experience and have the satisfaction of seeing your work impacting multiple advertising business and bring in multi-million transactions worth 100x in dollar value on a daily basis. This platform owns these mandates for worldwide advertising displayed On or Off Amazon. description: At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth. Role Overview: At PDI, we’re building AI-native products using agentic workflows. Our UX Design Team is small, but our impact is large! We’re looking for an AI-savvy designer who knows their way around the technical side of workflows and can help teams deliver compelling and easy to maintain experiences. Concept designs come from many sources from standard prototypes to system rewrites, and our UX team makes sure they come together as consistent, usable products. As a UI/UX Designer III, you'll be the design-to-code partner for your engineering teams, helping make sure what ships matches both the visual design and the coded components of our design system. Day to day, that might mean reviewing a pull request, keeping Figma and code in step, untangling a tricky UI issue or writing the specs and agent instructions that help teams get the UI right the first time. If you enjoy moving between Figma, a repo, a pull request and an AI agent in the same day, and you have a good instinct for which is the right place for each job, we'd love to hear from you. Key Responsibilities: Leverage AI-assisted tooling (e.g., prompt-to-layout generators, Figma-to-code plugins, and coding agent integrations) to rapidly prototype and accelerate the design-to-development pipeline. Decide what belongs in Figma (exploration, intent, visual specs) and what should go straight to code through agents. Guide product teams on that split. Write and maintain specs, prompts, skills and agent instructions that lead AI coding tools to produce interfaces that follow the design system. Review pulls requests for UI accuracy, correct use of components and tokens, responsive behaviour and accessibility before merge. Keep design and code in sync so components and tokens stay consistent from design files to production, and every change traces back to its design source. Spot where generated code drifts from the design system, and feed fixes back into the components, the tokens or the agent instructions. Serve as the main UI design contact for assigned product and engineering teams. Partner with developers, and the agents they direct, to implement approved designs accurately. Give guidance on layouts, interactions, responsive behaviour and component usage. Troubleshoot UI implementation problems and recommend solutions that follow our design standards. Prepare clean, well-structured Figma files and clear technical specs that developers and AI agents can act on. Run UI audits to find visual inconsistencies, incorrect component usage and implementation gaps, then log defects and work with developers to resolve them. Find gaps in existing components and tokens and recommend improvements. Maintain UI guidelines, component usage docs and implementation standards in Confluence and in the repo, where agents can read them. Document design decisions, approved patterns and reusable fixes for recurring problems. Write design system release notes and tell development teams about component changes. Help educate engineering teams on design system standards and the agentic workflow. Qualifications: 5+ years in UI design, UX engineering or front-end development in complex digital or enterprise products, including 2+ years on design systems and component-based interfaces. High proficiency in Figma, including component variants, auto-layout hierarchies, and design token management. Hands-on, daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar) for UI work. Can show examples of directing an agent to build or fix UI. Baseline technical literacy in modern front-end layouts to facilitate frictionless AI code handoff. Working knowledge of Git and pull-request workflows (GitHub or Azure DevOps): branches, reviewing diffs, leaving actionable review comments. Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2 AA) and UI best practices. Able to work with distributed teams across multiple time zones, primarily in US and India. Behavioral Competencies: Ensures Accountability Manages Complexity Communicates Effectively Balances Stakeholders Mandatory Skill Set: Deep expertise in mobile and tablet interaction patterns, including iOS and Android conventions. Designs for real-world settings such as store floors, fuel sites and on-the-go use, where speed and clarity matter. Turns complex desktop workflows into focused mobile experiences. Builds responsive and adaptive layouts across screen sizes. Portfolio shows mobile work in B2B or operational settings, not only consumer apps. Eye for detail catches visual and interaction inconsistencies that others and automated tools miss. Fluency with AI design workflows works comfortably in AI-assisted design-to-code workflows (Figma alongside AI coding tools such as Claude Code) and understands how design moves into code through repositories and pull requests. Works within a pattern library and extends it applies existing patterns faithfully and helps evolve the library when new needs come up PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all. low level Experience with networking layers , Retrofit, OkHttp, and custom network stack implementations Proficiency with data persistence strategies (Room, SQLite, DataStore, SharedPreferences, and structuring code for testability Ability to integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Jenkins, Gradle) 2+ years of experience leveraging AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub
